verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents maintained integrations with RAG or agent frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. The cited items are adjacent rather than story evidence: native client libraries in six languages are developer building blocks, and the MCP server and coding-assistant agent skills belong to different stories. The axis clearly applies to a vector database, so the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can plug the database into RAG and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) through maintained first-class integrations
